messages:
maya: Kicking off smoke tests for the eu-west4 GPU cluster bring-up. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/eu-west4-bringup — paste quick check results here (network / kube / GPU / storage / SLO gates). I'll collate and prepare handoff.
liam: Network quick checks done. ping to registry (10.120.5.8) avg=3ms. traceroute shows single hop to infra-proxy. curl -I https://registry.internal -> 200 OK. No iptables DROP rules observed.
jamie: GPU node health snapshot: ran `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,driver_version,utilization.gpu,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv`
```\nindex, name, driver_version, utilization.gpu [%], memory.total [MiB], memory.used [MiB]\n0, A100-SXM4-80GB, 525.60.13, 0 %, 81920 MiB, 512 MiB\n1, A100-SXM4-80GB, 525.60.13, 0 %, 81920 MiB, 480 MiB\n```\nNo ECC errors, temps fine.
devops: Autoscaler smoke: deployed `gpu-stress` job with nodeSelector `gpu=true`. Cluster autoscaled 2 -> 8 nodes in ~70s, pods started scheduling and became Ready in ~90s. Logs: `cluster-autoscaler` reported successful scale-up from capacity pool. Recommend keeping `scaleUpDelay` at 30s for now.
sre-bot: Health snapshot (short): node_ready=99.82%, pod_evictions=0, disk_iops=22% of budget, network_p95=12ms (SLO=20ms), controlplane_api_5xx=0.
maya: SLO gates quick eval: latency <20ms? yes (network p95=12ms). node_ready >99%? passing. pod_evictions? 0. GPU hardware errors? none. storage throughput? 22% usage, but one zone shows higher attach latency (~110s attach observed in zone-b, SLO=90s). Marking PRE-READY. Need ops/security handoff + fix for CSI attach timeout in zone-b.
liam: Found the CSI attach retries hitting default timeout in zone-b when contention peaks. Increased attach timeout to 120s in testing cluster; re-ran attach flow and it completed reliably. Will patch prod policy and re-trigger validation.
jamie: Ran inference smoke (locust-like): 100 requests sequentially against canary model on new cluster. Results: p50=25ms, p95=130ms (observed 1 request hit fallback quantized model causing p95 spike). Opened INF-3421 to tune batching/cold-start for that model.
devops: Cost estimate note: if we commit to Dedicated capacity for eu-west4 at 50% of current baseline, estimated monthly reserved = ~$18k. On-demand burst usage seen during stress tests would add ~2-3k. Recommend 50% commit, monitor for two weeks.
maya: OK. Blockers: CSI attach in zone-b (liam patching), model fallback causing occasional p95 spike (jamie filed INF-3421). Everything else within gates. Planning readiness review / handoff to ops in 30m at 15:30 UTC. @ops-eng please prepare the handoff doc (kubeconfigs rotated, runbook link, known issues list).
ops-eng: We'll take the handoff. Please include the kubeconfig rotation note, service-account key TTLs, and the policy change for CSI attach timeout. We'll verify secrets and KMS integration before marking fully ready.
maya: Pasting final lightweight checklist summary for handoff: 
- Network: registry/curl OK, proxy latency nominal
- Kube: control-plane 5xx=0, nodes Ready >99%
- GPU: `nvidia-smi` no errors, GPU memory free, drivers consistent
- Autoscaler: scale 2->8 ok, pods Ready within 90s
- Storage: disk IOPS within budget but zone-b attach latency observed -> patch applied
- SLO gates: network p95 < 20ms, node_ready>99%, pod_evictions=0 -> PRE-READY
- Tickets: INF-3421 (model canary tuning), INF-3422 (CSI attach timeout patch)
- Cost: recommend 50% reserved commit (~$18k/mo)
- Next: ops-eng to verify security/KMS and rotate kubeconfigs; then final readiness review.
liam: :+1: re: CSI patch deployed to prod; watching for regressions.
jamie: :white_check_mark: ran second inference smoke after patch, p95 improved to 95ms (no fallback hits).
ops-eng: Accepted — will take handoff and run security & kubeconfig checklist. ETA for final sign-off ~2 hours.
maya: Thanks team — marking this thread as bring-up smoke checks completed / handing to ops for readiness review.
